records.title: Coinbase Global Q3 2026 Form 10-Q: lending and derivatives collateral
records.xrp_specific_collateral: not disclosed; XRP not separately named in recognized derivative collateral table; unrecognized customer crypto collateral is not asset-level disaggregated
records.note: Other recognized lending crypto assets total only USD9.903M; unrecognized customer crypto collateral USD2.804B is not broken down by token. Do not infer zero total XRP collateral.

records.title: Circle Q2 2026 Form 10-Q: Coinbase/Binance distribution economics and SBI JV
records.distribution_costs_basis: Coinbase allocations depend on USDC held on its platform after issuer retention plus a share of broader ecosystem growth
records.note: Circle consolidates Circle SBI Japan K.K. because it controls the VIE despite 50% equity; SBI's share is noncontrolling interest. Circle's USDC-on-platform measure is not directly comparable to Coinbase's later Q3 average USDC-in-products measure.

records.title: Coinbase Q3 2026 earnings release
records.note: Annualized prediction-market run-rate is not recognized quarterly revenue. Circle Q2 platform balance definitions differ from Coinbase Q3 average product balance.

records.title: SBI Circle Holdings / Circle SBI Japan K.K. 50:50 joint venture
records.purpose: Promote USDC distribution in Japan and develop use cases
records.accounting_control: Circle controls and consolidates the VIE; SBI interest presented as noncontrolling interest
records.note: Equal equity does not imply equal accounting control or operating decision rights.

records.title: SBI strategic investment in Circle and Arc token presale participation
records.note: This USD50M strategic investment in Circle is separate from SBI's USD50M investment in Startale Group in March 2026.

records.title: JPYSC launch: trust-type yen stablecoin, initially limited to SBI VC Trade accounts
records.initial_availability: SBI VC Trade account balances only
records.public_chain_transfer: future conditional on legal and tax practice clarification

records.title: JPYSC backing assets include Japanese government bonds
records.note: JPY6.9B is applications, not confirmed lending. JPY1B JGB allocation is approximately 4.98% of the JPY20.1B reported issued balance.

records.title: SBI Holdings and SMBC Group capital/business alliance on stablecoin services
records.officially_confirmed: Capital and business alliance to jointly study new financial services using stablecoins and related technology
records.note: The SBI release confirms the alliance; approximately 5% investment detail is reported by secondary business press and should remain a sourced claim until the share subscription closes.

records.title: SBI, Startale and BlackRock MOU to connect tokenized MMF and JPYSC
